// Compile-only source consumer. Even malformed parsed inputs are never executed here.
use syntax_complete::{
    SyntaxNode,
    ast::{self, AstNode},
};
fn count<'t, N: AstNode<'t>>(root: SyntaxNode<'t>) -> usize {
    root.descendants().filter_map(N::cast).count()
}
fn main() {
    for text in [
        "fn f() {}",
        "fn broken( { if true {",
        "fn café<'a>(x: &'a str) -> &'a str { x }",
    ] {
        let parsed = syntax_complete::parse_source_file(text);
        let _ = parsed.errors();
        let _ = parsed.source_file().items().count();
        let _ = count::<ast::Fn<'_>>(parsed.root());
        let _ = count::<ast::Expr<'_>>(parsed.root());
    }
}
